description: Italian public procurement datasets from ANAC open data (dati.anticorruzione.it, CKAN): dataset title, publisher, licence, last modified date, number of resources and dataset link, for a search term. Catalogue metadata only, not the tender records. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_dati_gov_it_italy_open_data when you need Italian open government datasets from dati.gov.it: title; gov_ted_eu_procurement when you need EU public procurement notices from TED, filtered by buyer. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Search text, 2 to 80 characters (Italian or English)
